name: Competition
overview: Scripture reveals that true victory and success come through reliance on God, who empowers us to overcome adversaries and accomplish what seems impossible (Psalms 108:13; Luke 1:37). Earthly competition often breeds envy and is ultimately vain, as human esteem can be contrary to God's values (Ecclesiastes 4:4; Luke 16:15). Therefore, believers are called to prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness above worldly striving, recognizing that divine perspective reverses human rankings, where the first may be last and the last first (Matthew 6:33; Matthew 19:30).
